final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch (main) of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need at least one approving review before they can be merged. The branch is protected, and the rule applies to administrators as well.

arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:3c237d64-5f68-4b4b-a5dc-341babc89: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:1aa11169-ca8e-44a3-9f02-6f2384b47: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:41e92be3-f853-461c-b2b9-f8f23366a: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:a8782f63-a75a-4bae-a281-d5342bb78: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:210a7f77-6e17-44c0-8905-9b5028a79: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
